overloads.semanticRole: warning This command cannot be used in projects because the Picture library is only available in binary databases.

constraints: This command cannot be used in projects because the Picture Library is only available in binary (classic) databases.
If a Picture Library graphic with reference picRef already exists, its contents are replaced and it is renamed according to picture/picName; otherwise a new picture is added to the Picture Library.
If picture is empty, or picRef is negative or zero, the command does nothing.
Cannot be used from within a method executed on the 4D Server machine (stored procedure or trigger); calling it there is silently ignored.
